description: This Java class 'ConceptNameSaveHandler' handles the processing of 'ConceptName' objects during save operations within the OpenMRS framework. It particularly manages the lookup and replacement of 'ConceptNameTag' objects that lack identifiers, ensuring they are properly fetched and assigned from the database when necessary.

classes.name: ConceptNameSaveHandler
classes.description: Handler class that manages the saving process of 'ConceptName' objects, specifically replacing tags with null IDs with corresponding database entries.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a 'ConceptName' object by replacing its tags with null IDs with persisted database tags based on their names.
